title: Repair question-bank write contracts and authorization

spec.problem: Question-bank writes/permissions and Admin quiz-session detail/list/time-extension/abort contracts are broken.

acceptance.text: A valid UI-shaped request with JSON string-array tags creates a question, options, and audit entry; detail and list return the persisted question and tags.
Question, options, and creation audit commit atomically; a child or audit write failure returns HTTP 500 and persists none of the created rows.
PATCH, bulk tag, and bulk untag read and write PostgreSQL text[] tags successfully and return truthful persisted state.

Question-bank content mutations require assessment.manage; suggestion edits require assessment.review or assessment.manage. Admin session, CSRF, and unauthorized-role behavior are enforced by the backend.

Local question.section_id references bjt_test_section after a safe additive migration; the migration preserves any existing orphan rows without weakening enforcement for new writes and validates when data permits.
Required frontend verification passes: Loto pagination regression fixture supplies an authenticated state, and frontend lint introduces no new debt.

GET /api/admin/assessment/quiz-sessions/{id} returns the persisted session and answer contract for an existing session; missing IDs return 404, and database query failures are surfaced rather than mislabeled or silently omitted.

GET /api/admin/assessment/quiz-sessions returns persisted rows with nullable estimatedScore and the test summary expected by the Admin page; scan/query errors return 500 instead of silently dropping rows.
Admin time extension requires an in_progress session, shifts started_at by the requested seconds, and commits an audit entry atomically; DB failures must not be reported as success.
Aborting an in_progress Admin quiz session updates status to abandoned and stores the audit record atomically without relying on nonexistent updated_at; terminal-session no-op remains auditable.

spec.expected_behavior: A valid create either persists the question, all options, and audit record together, or persists none and returns a failure.
spec.observed_behavior: Visible authenticated Admin abort confirmation for an in_progress disposable session returned HTTP 500 because the handler references quiz_session.updated_at, which is absent from the canonical schema.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert only the scoped Go handler/router/tests and corrective migration. The FK change is additive; prior mismatches remain data-preserving because the FK starts NOT VALID if legacy orphans exist.
